title: Feature plan (RFC-0008): the slices of a feature, the files each owns and the slices each depends on
description: A Planner, a person or an imported tool proposes it; `a2dlc plan check` judges it against the feature's intent before any Builder runs (RFC-0008 section 3). owns are globs of the files a slice may change; two slices with no dependency path between them must own no file in common. shared lists files that more than one slice may change, and only slices ordered by depends_on may share one.

feature_id.description: The slice_id of the feature's intent.

shared.description: Globs of files more than one slice may change; every slice that owns one must lie on one dependency path.

goal.description: What the slice changes and why, written for the person who approves the plan.

owns.description: Globs of the files the slice may change (repository-relative, the glob syntax of config.protected_paths).

covers.description: Indexes (0-based) of the feature intent's acceptance criteria this slice is responsible for.
